additional_observations: The three Android text exports contain the tail of each payload-size run and report remote_finished with 20 successful attempts and 0 failed attempts; the complete iPhone export records all attempts, receipts, and matching hashes.

The iPhone export contains three foreground size runs (256, 2048, and 8192 bytes) and a separate 2048-byte run that continued after the app entered background. The lock-screen Live Activity shows 20 sent and 20 received.
A separate earlier three-phone probe used serial point-to-point encounters and did not establish simultaneous connections or multi-hop delivery; those remain M2 work.
limitations: This gate exchanges synthetic generated bytes, not field reports, and does not test report relevance, encryption, or relay routing.
The screen-off observation is a single owner-reported test; it does not establish reliable unattended discovery across devices, OS versions, or extended durations.
